documents.title: Responsible Use of Generative AI
documents.summary: Provost page that defines generative AI, states university values, and gives faculty considerations on communicating a syllabus policy, protecting data, accountability and research-related disclosure. It names the default that unauthorized student AI use is cheating and points to Copilot and an IT tool-evaluation service.
documents.stance_why: The page states a default ("using AI tools as a substitute for their authentic intellectual and creative work is cheating unless instructors say otherwise") but is framed as "Faculty Considerations" telling instructors to "Communicate your policy on AI tool use", so the decision on use is handed to instructors.

units.why: Defines GAI as a system that generates content "in response to a prompt" from large data sets; it sets what the page covers, so informs/general and P61.

units.why: Says 'the quality of GAI output varies in terms of accuracy and bias', a fact about unreliable output, closest to P31 (verify output). It states a fact, not a duty, so modality is informs.
units.anchor: the quality of GAI output varies in terms of accuracy and bias
units.fit_note: States the fact of variable accuracy and bias but does not tell anyone to verify. / Also says output accuracy varies (P31) but no duty to verify is stated.
units.resolution_why: States as fact that output accuracy and bias vary ("the quality of GAI output varies in terms of accuracy and bias"), as background to the later warning that tools "make mistakes". It is a general statement for everyone, so actor all, phase general, modality informs; accuracy unreliability is the main content, so P31 rather than P53.

units.resolution_why: A: actor admin, B: all. The value statement ("supports the thoughtful application of new technologies, such as generative artificial intelligence (GAI)") is the university's principle for the whole community and binds no single office, so actor all.

units.why: Says GAI is "not a substitute" for human-to-human education and research; a principle in the framework (P56), also a reason AI should not replace human work. (Final actor/phase/modality/type follow the reconciliation; see resolution_why.)

units.fit_note: Also says AI is support, not a substitute for human-centered teaching, close to P32 but at institution level. / Also expresses that AI should not replace human interaction (close to P32/P41) but is stated as a university value.
units.resolution_why: Task-force value that GAI tools "provide support for but are not a substitute for" human-centered education and research. A university-level principle for everyone (actor all, phase general, modality informs), with no limit on use, so P56 and unit_stance neutral.
